item.title: Gabbard’s expanded role in election security draws scrutiny
item.description: Since the start of the year, the White House chief of staff and DHS secretary have met multiple times to discuss election security, and DNI Tulsi Gabbard has been present in at least one of those meetings, according to a U.S. official.

item.title: Navigating FedRAMP 20x and the continuous compliance imperative
item.description: COMMENTARY | FedRAMP 20x is a great step forward, but there is still work to be done.

item.title: Trump’s nutrition website directs users to Elon Musk’s Grok
item.description: The inclusion of Elon Musk’s chatbot in the government website follows backlash over the chatbot creating millions of sexualized images of women and children.

item.title: White House will hold meeting to discuss renewal of controversial spying power
item.description: Section 702 of the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act is set to expire this spring unless renewed by lawmakers.

item.title: Dem lawmakers propose 4.1% raise for feds in 2027
item.description: The annual reintroduction of the Federal Adjustment of Income Rates Act aims to set a baseline for negotiations around federal employee compensation for the coming year.

item.title: Announcing the 2026 Federal 100
item.description: These 100 people made exceptional contributions to the government IT ecosystem last year.

item.title: CISA’s acting chief says 70 staff were reassigned to other DHS offices in last year
item.description: The cyberdefense agency in turn received some 30 employees from other DHS components, while a “handful” of CISA staffers were transferred to ICE, Madhu Gottumukkala told lawmakers.

item.title: FPDS looks old and clunky but that only masks its power
item.description: With the Federal Procurement Data System set for decommissioning this month, market research guru Lisa Shea Mundt makes the case that we’ll miss FPDS and not just because we’ll feel nostalgic.

item.title: Senators to revive reform effort for controversial spying law
item.description: The proposed changes to Section 702 of FISA would mandate warrants for searches of U.S. person communications and revisit a 2024 provision that critics say widened the government’s surveillance reach.

item.title: CMS built a waitlist for its AI chatbot — and that drove momentum — official says
item.description: The approach helped the agency get more targeted insights from those familiar with the emerging capabilities.
